steps.text: Get up when Navi finishes shouting and walk out the front door of your house onto the wooden balcony.
steps.detail: The opening nightmare and Navi's flight over the village play first; you take control standing inside the treehouse.

steps.text: Climb down the ladder from the balcony to the grass below.
steps.detail: Face the ladder and press A to grab it, then hold back on the stick to descend.

steps.text: Talk to Saria waiting at the foot of the ladder.
steps.detail: She only cheers your new fairy and tells you to go see the Great Deku Tree. Skippable, but she is right in your path.

steps.text: Walk southwest across the village to the fenced Forest Training Center, the bottom-left corner of the map.
steps.detail: Follow the grass past Mido's House and up the slope. The Training Center is the low fenced pen with a sign on the wall.

steps.text: Face the small hole in the wall beside the sign, press A to crawl in and hold forward until you pop out the far side.
steps.detail: This crawlspace is the only way into the sword maze.

steps.text: Round the first corner and pick up the Blue Rupee lying there.
steps.detail: Worth 5. The maze rupees come back if you leave the Training Center and walk in again.

steps.text: Turn around and wait against the wall for the giant rolling boulder to pass you.
steps.detail: It loops the maze on a fixed track and knocks you back if it touches you. Let it go by, never try to squeeze past it.

steps.text: Fall in behind the boulder and follow it, then take the first passage on the right.
steps.detail: Stay close behind it and you always have the whole loop of clearance in front of you.

steps.text: Grab the second Blue Rupee in that right-hand passage.
Step back out behind the boulder and carry on to the next alcove along the maze.
steps.detail: Wait for the boulder to come round again if you are not sure you can beat it to the alcove.

steps.text: Open the large chest in the alcove for the Kokiri Sword.
Pause, open the Equipment screen and select the Kokiri Sword to equip it.
steps.detail: The sword goes on the B button. On Switch Online use the Start button to pause, then the shoulder buttons to reach Equipment.

steps.text: Follow the maze back around to the crawl hole and crawl out into the Training Center.
steps.detail: Keep watching for the boulder on the way back; the track is the same.

steps.text: Talk to the Kokiri boy standing just outside the crawl hole, then Z-target the rock and backflip by holding back and pressing A.
steps.detail: He teaches the backflip and the spot pays out rupees. Part of the 40 you need for the shield.

steps.text: Go into Mido's House, the building directly across from the crawl hole, and open the chests inside for rupees.
Walk around the back of Mido's House and pick up the Blue Rupee hidden there.
Climb the ramp beside Saria's House, next door to your own, and follow it toward the middle of the village for the rupee at the top.
Run across the two stone platforms in the water between Mido's House and the shop; Link hops them on his own and collects 5 rupees.
Duck into any house and come straight back out to make the village rupees respawn, then repeat the spots until your wallet reads 40.
steps.detail: Every loose rupee lying in Kokiri Forest regenerates on a room reload, so the 40 for the shield is only a couple of laps.

steps.text: Z-target the Kokiri girl sitting above the shop doorway and press A to talk to her.
steps.detail: She is the game's Z-targeting tutorial. Nothing is lost by walking past her.

steps.text: Enter the Kokiri Shop, the building in the northeast corner of the village.
Pick up the hidden Blue Rupee tucked against the side wall of the shop.
Step up to the counter and buy the Deku Shield for 40 Rupees.
Pause, open the Equipment screen and equip the Deku Shield alongside the Kokiri Sword.
steps.detail: Mido checks for both. With neither equipped he keeps refusing no matter what is in your inventory.

steps.text: Leave the shop and talk to Mido, who is blocking the north path out of the village.
steps.detail: He insults you and steps aside once he sees the sword and shield.

steps.text: Follow the narrow path north toward the Great Deku Tree.
Slash the three Withered Deku Babas that pop up near the end of the path.
steps.detail: They never move and never attack. One slash each.

steps.text: Pick up the Deku Sticks they drop.
steps.detail: Deku Sticks appear in your inventory; you will need them for every torch in the dungeon.

steps.text: Talk to the Great Deku Tree and answer Yes when he asks whether you are willing to break his curse.
Walk into the Great Deku Tree's open mouth to enter the dungeon.
Kill the Deku Babas growing out of the floor of the entrance room on 1F.
steps.detail: Z-target one, hold R to block the lunge, then slash when it snaps back. They drop Deku Nuts.

steps.text: Pause and assign Deku Sticks and Deku Nuts to your C buttons.
steps.detail: Without them on C you cannot light a torch or throw a nut, and both come up within minutes.

steps.text: Slash the weeds around the 1F floor for Recovery Hearts if the Babas caught you.
steps.detail: The weeds grow back, so this is a repeatable heart source. Note the big web in the middle of the floor; you break it much later, from above.

steps.text: Climb the wooden ladder on the side of the tower up to the 2F ledge.
steps.detail: The vines next to it work too. Navi stops you to explain climbing either way.

steps.text: Follow the 2F ledge clockwise around the room until you reach the large chest.
steps.detail: You pass a patch of vines with Skullwalltulas crawling on them. Leave them for now; you come back with the Slingshot.

steps.text: Open the large chest on the 2F ledge for the Dungeon Map.
Carry on right along the 2F ledge and jump the gap to the next platform.
steps.detail: Run straight at the gap; Link jumps automatically at the edge.

steps.text: Jump across to the last platform on 2F and go through the door at the end.
Z-target the Deku Scrub and hold R so the nut it spits bounces off your shield and stuns it.
steps.detail: Stay several paces back or it ducks into its hole before it fires.

steps.text: Run the stunned Scrub down and talk to it before it burrows.
steps.detail: Its hint is the roll landing: hold the stick forward as you touch down from a long fall. The far door opens when it flees.

steps.text: Pick up the Recovery Hearts it leaves behind.
Go through the door that opened on the far side of the room.
Jump onto the platform in the middle of the room; it starts to crumble the moment you land.
steps.detail: Do not stop on it. Keep moving the instant your feet touch.

steps.text: Jump straight on from the crumbling platform to the far ledge.
steps.detail: If you drop into the pit, climb the vines on the wall back up to the ledge.

steps.text: Open the large chest on the ledge for the Fairy Slingshot.
steps.detail: This is the dungeon's main item. Its ammo is Deku Seeds, which drop from slashed bushes.

steps.text: Climb the vines beside the chest up to the hidden alcove above.
Open the small chest in the alcove for a Recovery Heart.
Drop back down, face the door you came in by and Z-target the ladder hanging on the wall above it.
steps.detail: The platform you jumped from is gone, so the ladder is the only way back.

steps.text: Shoot the hanging ladder with the Fairy Slingshot so it swings down into place.
Climb the ladder and go back through the door to the 2F ledge of the main room.
Walk back around 2F to the vine patch by the Dungeon Map chest and shoot every Skullwalltula off the vines with the Fairy Slingshot.
steps.detail: Left alive they bite you mid-climb and knock you all the way back to 1F.

steps.text: Climb the vines all the way to the very top.
Shuffle sideways along the top of the vines, left or right, until you are hanging over the 3F walkway.
Let go of the vines to drop onto the 3F walkway, the highest floor of the main room.
Work along the 3F walkway past the Big Skulltulas hanging over it.
steps.detail: They only drop when you get close. Stand just near enough to bring one down, wait for it to spin and show its soft belly, then slash. You can also shoot the belly from range with the Fairy Slingshot.

steps.text: Go through the door at the end of the 3F walkway.
Step on the floor switch in this room to raise the three sunken platforms.
Hop across the three platforms to the far side of the room before they sink again.
steps.detail: They stay up only a few seconds. If you fall, walk back and hit the switch again.

steps.text: Open the large chest on the far side for the Compass.
Drop down to the floor of the Compass room.
steps.detail: Start of the detour for Gold Skulltula #1. Skip all of it if you are not collecting.

steps.text: Kill the Big Skulltula hanging on the right-hand side of the room.
Kill the Deku Baba growing in front of the vines.
Climb the vines back up to the ledge with the floor switch.
Step on the floor switch a second time to raise the platforms again.
Hop across the platforms to the alcove on the left this time.
Open the small chest in the left alcove for a Recovery Heart.
Kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall behind that chest and touch the Gold Skulltula token it drops.
steps.detail: Slash it or shoot it with the Fairy Slingshot, then walk into the token. First of the 100 tokens in the game.

steps.text: Jump down from the alcove and climb the vines back up to the ledge with the barred door.
steps.detail: The door you came in by is barred; the two torches beside it are the lock.

steps.text: Take out a Deku Stick and hold it in the lit torch until it catches fire.
Carry the burning stick to the unlit torch and stand next to it so the flame jumps across; the bars on the door disappear.
Press B to draw your sword the moment the second torch catches, so the rest of the Deku Stick is saved.
steps.detail: A lit stick burns down to nothing in about ten seconds. Switching weapons puts it away intact.

steps.text: Go back through the unbarred door to the 3F walkway of the main room.
Kill the Big Skulltula guarding the edge of the 3F walkway.
steps.detail: You need the edge clear to line up the jump; it will knock you off otherwise.

steps.text: Stand on the edge of 3F and line yourself up with the web lying in the middle of the 1F floor far below.
Jump off the 3F walkway and land dead centre on the web; it tears and drops you into the flooded basement.
steps.detail: Catch only the rim and the web bounces you like a trampoline. Climb all the way back up and aim again.

steps.text: Look up at the vines on the basement wall that lead back to the floor above and shoot the Gold Skulltula crawling on them with the Fairy Slingshot.
Climb the vines and touch the Gold Skulltula token.
Shoot the Gold Skulltula sitting on the grating at the north end of the basement with the Fairy Slingshot.
Climb the platform beside the grating, jump across and take the Gold Skulltula token.
Climb onto the platform in the basement and step on the floor switch; the torch next to it lights and burns off the cobweb covering it.
steps.detail: That torch is the flame source for everything left in the basement, so remember where it is.

steps.text: Light a Deku Stick on the newly lit torch.
Run across the shallow water to the platform on the far side of the room with the stick still burning.
steps.detail: Keep to the shallow part where Link walks. The moment he starts swimming the flame goes out.

steps.text: Burn the cobwebs covering the door on that platform.
Go through the door behind the burned cobwebs.
Z-target the Deku Scrub here and reflect its nut back with your shield.
steps.detail: Same trick as the first Scrub: hold R and stay back.

steps.text: Chase it down before it burrows and listen to its hint: 2, 3, 1.
steps.detail: That is the order for the three-Scrub puzzle at the bottom of the dungeon. Middle, right, left.

steps.text: Slash the bushes in this room for Deku Seeds if your Slingshot ammo is low.
Shoot the silver eye switch mounted above the next door with the Fairy Slingshot.
Go through the door the eye switch opened.
Jump into the water and swim to the left side of the room.
steps.detail: Navi stops you here to explain diving.

steps.text: Get over the underwater switch on the bottom, hold A to dive and steer onto it; the water level drops.
steps.detail: Use the stick to swim down and forward. The water only stays low for a short while.

steps.text: Swim back to the first platform and climb the ramp on it.
Wait for the floating platform to drift over to your side and jump onto it.
steps.detail: If the water rises before you board, dive for the switch again.

steps.text: Ride the floating platform under the spinning spiked log to the far side of the room.
steps.detail: Stay crouched in the middle of the raft; the log passes right overhead.

steps.text: Climb up onto the ledge on the far side.
Kill the Big Skulltula hanging over this ledge.
Stand against the side of the stone block and push or pull it until it sits directly under the doorway.
steps.detail: Walk into a face of the block and hold A, then push or pull with the stick. Navi explains it the first time.

steps.text: Walk into the block and press A to climb on top of it.
Go through the door above the block.
Kill the Deku Baba and the Withered Deku Baba in this room and collect what they drop.
Light a Deku Stick on the one lit torch in the room.
Light the two unlit torches with the burning stick.
steps.detail: Take the near one first, then the far one; the stick only lasts so long.

steps.text: Go through the door that opens once both torches burn.
Stand in the doorway, Z-target the Big Skulltula straight ahead and shoot it twice with the Fairy Slingshot before you step inside.
steps.detail: From this far back it stays hanging with its soft side turned toward you, so you kill it for free.

steps.text: Walk forward past the three shadows in the middle of the room; eggs drop from the ceiling and hatch into Gohma Larvae.
Z-target one Gohma Larva at a time, get close and slash it until all three are dead.
steps.detail: They are only dangerous as a pack. Two sword swipes or one jump attack each.

steps.text: Light a Deku Stick on the torch in this room.
Carry the flame to the cobweb at the far end of the room and burn it.
steps.detail: The other cobweb in this room hides a wall you cannot open yet. The Gold Skulltula behind it needs Bombs and is collected in a later chapter.

steps.text: Crawl through the hole behind the burned cobweb.
Kill the Deku Babas on the ledge you come out on, the upper level of the flooded basement.
steps.detail: Optional; they are easy to walk past.

steps.text: Push the stone block on this ledge off the edge to open a permanent shortcut back up.
Jump down off the ledge and land beside the block you just dropped.
Light a Deku Stick on the low torch you lit with the floor switch earlier.
steps.detail: The two torches up on the ledge are mounted too high to reach with a stick.

steps.text: Climb the fallen block back up onto the ledge with the stick still lit.
steps.detail: This is why the block had to go over first; the climb is the only route fast enough.

steps.text: Burn the cobweb in the floor of the ledge with the lit stick.
steps.detail: Roll into it with A or swing the stick with its C button. Either one sets it alight.

steps.text: Drop through the burned floor into the deepest part of the dungeon.
Dive in the water down here for Recovery Hearts before the boss.
Climb out onto the land in front of the three Deku Scrubs.
Reflect the middle Deku Scrub's nut back at it first.
steps.detail: This is the 2 in the 2, 3, 1 hint. Hit them out of order and all three reset.

steps.text: Reflect the right-hand Deku Scrub's nut back at it second.
Reflect the left-hand Deku Scrub's nut back at it last; the boss door unlocks.
Catch the last Deku Scrub before it runs off and listen to its hint about the boss.
Go through the boss door.
Look up at Queen Gohma clinging to the ceiling to start the fight.
steps.detail: Nothing happens until you look up. Keep the Fairy Slingshot on a C button.

steps.text: Block her lunge with your shield or sidestep it when she wobbles toward you.
steps.detail: This is her only contact attack and it is slow. Z-target her and hold R.

steps.text: Slash the three eggs she drops from the ceiling before they hatch.
steps.detail: Miss one and it becomes a Gohma Larva a few seconds later.

steps.text: Kill any Gohma Larva that does hatch with two sword slashes or a jump attack.
Shoot her eye with the Fairy Slingshot the instant it glows red and she crashes to the floor.
steps.detail: The eye turns red right before and right after each of her attacks. Stunning her while she is still on the ceiling knocks her down for far longer than stunning her on the ground. A Deku Nut works too, but the Slingshot is much easier.

steps.text: Slash her eye with your sword over and over while she lies stunned.
steps.detail: Keep hitting until she gets back up; every extra swing counts.

steps.text: Repeat the stun and slash until she disintegrates.
steps.detail: Done cleanly from the ceiling, the whole fight takes under a minute.

steps.text: Take the Heart Container left in her remains.
Step into the blue light to warp out of the dungeon.
Listen to the Great Deku Tree's story about the man from the desert and the three Spiritual Stones.
steps.detail: He explains the Sacred Realm and the Triforce, and that the curse laid on him for refusing the stone cannot be lifted.

steps.text: Take the Kokiri's Emerald when he gives it to you.
steps.detail: The Spiritual Stone of the Forest, the first of the three.

steps.text: Watch the Great Deku Tree wither and die, then walk back down the path into Kokiri Forest.
steps.detail: He sends you to find the Princess of Destiny at Hyrule Castle. The next chapter starts at the village exit.
